senses.gloss:
Akra. — In several passages of the Rigveda^1 this word means,
according to Geldner,^2 ‘horse.’ Roth^3 suggests that ‘riding
horse’ is the precise sense. Cf. Aśva.
1) i. 143, 7; 189, 7; iii. 1, 12; iv. 6, 3;
x. 77, 2.
2) Vedische Studien, 1, 168, 169.
3) Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgen-
ländischen Gesellschaft, 48, 118. Cf. Max
Müller, Sacred Books of the East, 32, 414.

Ā-kramaṇa. — In the Jaiminīya Upaniṣad Brāhmaṇa^1 (i. 3)
this word is used with the specific sense of ‘steps to climb
trees.’
